description:
Incorporated in 1988, Transworld Shipping Lines Ltd is a container feeder-owning and operating company [1]

Key Points:
Business Overview: [1] [2] TSLL owns and operates vessels for container feeder operations between Indian and international trans-shipment ports and has diversified into logistics, transportation, warehousing and distribution services. Following the sale of its containerised domestic coastal and EXIM feeder shipping business to Avana, the Company follows an asset-heavy model focused on vessel ownership and long-term chartering.
